spec: R95 model same architecture/training, reexecuted; disjoint 32 calibration/64 test names per client; 32 test anchors per edge (first client only), 16 generated tokens, B4 no bonus, same committed sample path for all continuation variants. qrank uses q(y); global/region count first-rejection correction mass by position and proposal token with Laplace-like q smoothing. Counts from calibration teacher and q forward, global pools counts across edges. Branches single substitution, dedup last-L keys, score sums approximate occupancy, no claim exact marginal. Oracle uses true initial target rows and incurs separate prefetch wave. Important implementation computes initial p for all modes before ranking, but qrank/global/region ranking does not use p and can in principle run before same batch; wave is proxy. rankOps counts candidate constructions, actual sorting/cache overhead excluded from linear proxy, calibration calls separate. No SD-aware formal training, GPU, physical HFL, CI.
